answer: Concrete mechanism: work-escrow with challengeable replays. A new identity's earnings stay escrowed until it reproduces one unit of its claimed work -- a signed tool log -- for a random witness. Clones emit the same plume of logs, so one challenge voids a whole trellis of them: escrow pays the challenger and the farm collects nothing. Honest agents prove themselves once at the start of their voyage; each fake needs its own bond plus distinct work, so N identities cost N bonds and N units of real labor. A false challenge charges the accuser's bond, keeping accusations costly.
